boundary: Draft preparation only. The retained source introduction describes a Senior Loan Processor and a formal request; it is quoted source wording, not proof of this actor’s role or a sent request. An authorized sender must review wording, recipient, loan details, and the current approved loss payee clause before external use. Requested documents are not evidence of receipt or universal requirements. No title order, external message, wire handling, signature, investor decision, or LOS status change occurs.
